summary: Completed testing of Admin Professions Management feature - Backend API (17/17 tests PASS) and Frontend UI (all features working). Full hierarchy tested: Profession -> Sub-profession -> Category with CRUD operations.

issues: Cookie consent dialog appears on page load - minor UX concern but not a bug

Hierarchy model works: Profession contains sub_professions array, each sub_profession contains categories array
Authorization properly enforced - non-admin users get 403 Forbidden
Default professions initialized on first load (5 default professions with specializations)
Public API /api/professions returns simplified profession list with specializations
